name: sample_dirichlet
description: Representative upstream schema: aten::_sample_dirichlet(Tensor self, Generator? generator=None) -> Tensor. The artifact maps to the private canonical base _sample_dirichlet and draws a simplex sample for every last-dimension concentration vector without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover one- and multi-row inputs, K=1 and K>1024, positive and tiny concentrations, simplex normalization, symmetric and skewed distribution properties, generator reproducibility/state advancement, input preservation, and rejected non-floating inputs.
